title: Agent Talk service token claims
description: The payload of the bearer token a service calls another service's A2A endpoint with: which service calls, the endpoint it is for, and an id the receiver remembers so the same token is never taken twice.
$comment: Protected header: { "alg": "EdDSA", "kid": <key id in the issuer's keys>, "typ": "JWT" } (see $defs/protectedHeader). Checks only code can do: the signature against a key the receiver holds for iss; aud equal to the receiving endpoint; iat at most 5 minutes ahead of the receiver's clock; exp at most 300 seconds after iat; now before exp; jti not seen before. The reference implementation only checks that iss and aud are strings.

aud.description: The A2A endpoint the token is for.
